summary: The scroll’s self-centered fire blast reaches an ignitable object in the hero’s inventory. C apply.c catch_lit() handles the carried potion of oil and starts its burn; js/apply_catch_lit.js instead throws for OBJ_INVENT, stopping the only remaining screen before the explosion finishes.

source.branch: For an unlit ignitable object whose location is found and which passes the empty, burnt-out, brass-lantern, cursed-candelabrum, and cursed-lamp guards, catch_lit() reports the object when carried, discovers potion of oil, bills carried unpaid stock in a costly shop, starts burning, and returns TRUE. This case reaches that branch for a potion of oil after an unconfused uncursed scroll of fire hits the hero.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:4465-4467 fire_damage() calls catch_lit(obj) and uses TRUE to skip further burning; js/trap_water_damage.js fire_damage() wires catch_item_light as its default catchLit operation.
nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:7161-7171 ignite_items() calls catch_lit(obj) for each object that is neither lamplit nor in_use; js/apply_catch_lit.js ignite_items() calls catch_item_light().

nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:1850-1917 seffect_fire() calls explode.c explode(); nethack-c/upstream/src/explode.c:613-617 handles hero fire damage by calling trap.c ignite_items(gi.invent) before zap.c destroy_items(). The JS route is js/read.js seffect_fire() -> js/explode.js explode() -> js/apply_catch_lit.js ignite_items() -> catch_item_light().

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/apply.c:1577-1623 is the complete catch_lit() definition. Its eligible carried-object branch at 1598-1621 prints the light message, makes POT_OIL known, handles shop billing, calls begin_burn(), and returns TRUE. js/apply_catch_lit.js:60-99 mirrors earlier guards but throws UnsupportedItemIgnitionError for every surviving OBJ_INVENT object instead of this source branch; the implementation scope is the whole catch_lit() function, not a correction to the existing branches.

Caller trace: nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:7161-7171 ignite_items() reaches catch_lit(); nethack-c/upstream/src/explode.c:613-617 reaches ignite_items(gi.invent) for hero AD_FIRE; nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:1850-1917 seffect_fire() places an uncursed, unconfused scroll explosion at the hero. The other direct caller, trap.c:4455-4467 fire_damage(), consumes catch_lit()’s boolean return. Existing JS wiring is js/apply_catch_lit.js ignite_items() and js/trap_water_damage.js fire_damage().
